description: This Java class 'SecuredUpload' provides security-related methods for validating uploaded files in a web application. It includes checks for file extensions, file content, embedded malicious code, file types (images, PDFs, CSVs, videos, audio), and embedded documents within archives. The class implements various security measures to prevent webshells, reverse shells, and malicious payloads from being uploaded.

classes.name: SecuredUpload
classes.description: Main class providing static methods for validating and securing uploaded files to prevent security vulnerabilities such as webshells, malicious scripts, and unsafe files in a web application.

methods.name: isValidText
methods.description: Checks if a text content is valid, particularly looking for webshell tokens and unsafe concatenations.

methods.name: isValidFileName
methods.description: Validates that a filename is safe, checking for double extensions, invalid characters, and disallowed extensions.

methods.name: isValidAllFile
methods.description: Validates a file of type 'All' in general.

methods.name: isValidFile
methods.description: Validates a file based on its type (e.g., Image, PDF, Text), including deep content validation.

methods.name: isValidImageFile
methods.description: Checks whether a file is a supported and safe image format (PNG, GIF, TIFF, JPEG).

methods.name: noWebshellInMetadata
methods.description: Checks image metadata for potential webshell code or malicious content.

methods.name: noWebshellInPNG
methods.description: Checks for suspicious content inside PNG files, especially within IDAT chunks.

methods.name: isPNG
methods.description: Determines if a file is a PNG image.

methods.name: inflate
methods.description: Decompresses zlib/Deflate compressed data, used during PNG validation.

methods.name: isValidImageIncludingSvgFile
methods.description: Checks if the file is a valid image or an SVG.

methods.name: isValidSvgFile
methods.description: Validates if an SVG file is well-formed and safe.

methods.name: isPdfFile
methods.description: Checks if a file is a PDF based on file signature.

methods.name: isValidPdfFile
methods.description: Performs a comprehensive check that a PDF file is safe and does not contain malicious scripts or embedded insecure content.

methods.name: isValidCsvFile
methods.description: Validates whether a CSV file is well-formed and safe for processing.

methods.name: isExecutable
methods.description: Detects if a file is an Windows or Linux executable or script, and disallows such uploads.

methods.name: isValidCompressedFile
methods.description: Checks if an archive (ZIP) file is valid, safe, and does not contain malicious files or nested unsafe archives.

methods.name: getMimeTypeFromFileName
methods.description: Detects MIME type of a file based on filename extension or content.

methods.name: isValidDirectoryInCompressedFile
methods.description: Recursively validates files within an archive, ensuring none are malicious.

methods.name: recursiveParserWrapper
methods.description: Extracts embedded documents and metadata from container/archive files for analysis.

methods.name: isValidAudioFile
methods.description: Checks if a file is a supported and safe audio format.

methods.name: isValidVideoFile
methods.description: Checks if a file is a supported and safe video format.

methods.name: isValidTextFile
methods.description: Validates the content of a text file, ensuring it does not contain security threats like XLink or ENTITY references.

methods.name: isValid
methods.description: Performs a security check to ensure the content does not contain forbidden strings or scripts.

methods.name: deleteBadFile
methods.description: Deletes a file that has failed validation checks.

methods.name: checkMaxLinesLength
methods.description: Enforces maximum line length in uploaded text files to prevent payloads or malicious content.
